title: The body weight and measurement graph would show all history free once MettleUp Plus is on
what: MettleUp Plus says charts older than 3 months are paid. The Profile chart, the Statistics charts and the exercise chart ask the free-plan rule before showing a long range. The Body page graph never asks: it always draws every day ever logged. Dormant today because the plan switch is off for everyone.
expected: Either the Body graph follows the same 3-month free rule as the other charts, or the paid-plan wording says body graphs stay free.
who: members on the free part, once Plus is switched on
how_often: every visit to the Body page after Plus goes live
fix_line: Decide whether body graphs are paid; then either add the same check or change the paid-plan words

title: Following a plan with no own weekly goal: the home-screen widget shows a goal, the Workout tab does not
what: When a member follows a plan and has not set a weekly goal, the home-screen widget uses the plan's days a week as the goal ("1 of 3"). The Up next card on the Workout tab only reads the member's own goal setting, so it shows no goal line at all for the same week.
expected: The Up next card and the widget use the same goal: the member's own, or else the followed plan's days a week.
who: members following a plan without their own weekly goal
fix_line: Give the Up next card the same goal fallback the widget uses

title: A bio changed or removed on Edit profile stays visible to gym mates for hours
what: Gym mates see the member's bio on their shared profile. Saving a new or empty bio on Edit profile only saves it on the phone; nothing re-sends the shared profile. It is sent again only after the next saved workout or on an app start or return at most every 6 hours, so gym mates keep seeing the old words, even words the member deleted on purpose.
expected: Changing or clearing the bio re-sends the shared profile at once (while sharing with gym mates is on).
who: gym members who share with gym mates and edit their bio
fix_line: Send the shared profile again right after a bio save

title: A hidden exercise comes back in swap choices and new plans
what: Hiding a library exercise promises it "leaves every exercise list". The exercise list, the picker and the import matcher respect it. The swap choices during a workout or on a plan, and the plan builder's picks, never read the hidden list, so they can offer or add the exercise the member hid.
expected: Swap choices and new plans skip exercises the member hid, or the hide message says they may still be suggested.
how_often: when a swap or new plan picks a hidden exercise
fix_line: Pass the hidden list into swap choices and the plan builder
